newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turks boo prime minister Erbakan at soccer match.
newsitem.headline: Turks boo prime minister Erbakan at soccer match.

text.p: Turkish soccer fans booed and chanted anti-Islamist slogans at Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan when he appeared at a cup final match to present the trophy, newspapers said on Wednesday.
"Turkey is secularist and will say that way," the Hurriyet daily quoted supporters of both teams, Trabzonspor and Besiktas, as chanting at Erbakan during Tuesday night's game in Ankara.

Erbakan, who became modern Turkey's first Islamist prime minister last year, turned up at the match midway through the second half. He sat silently through 20 minutes of protests before handing the Prime Minister's Cup to 4-0 winners Trabzonspor.
The secularists in the military, media and opposition have criticised Erbakan recently for attempts to increase the role of Islam in public life.
The powerful army has ordered Erbakan's coalition to crack down on Islamist activism.
